festive.name: Festive mode
festive.intro: A light Christmas layer: the Festive Edit message, the Winter Berry print in the hero and a few slow drifting stars. Turn it off in January.

social.name: Social media
social.intro: Links show as icons in the footer. Leave a field empty to hide that icon.

whatsapp.name: WhatsApp
whatsapp.number_info: Country code and number, digits only, for example 919876543210. The button hides while this is empty.

cart.name: Cart
cart.open_on_add: Open the cart drawer after adding to cart
cart.free_shipping_info: Shows a progress bar in the cart drawer. Set 0 to hide it.

brand.name: Brand
brand.favicon_info: Square, at least 180 x 180 px. Leave empty to use the fern block icon.
brand.share_image_info: Shown when a page without its own image is shared, 1200 x 630 px works best.

announcement_bar.name: Announcement bar
announcement_bar.festive_only_info: Shows only while festive mode is on (Theme settings, Festive mode).

header.name: Header
header.logo_info: Leave empty to show the store name in the display font.

feature.name: Menu feature
feature.menu_item_info: Type the title of a top level menu item exactly, for example Table. Its mega menu shows this photo.
feature.heading: Heading
feature.link_info: Leave empty to use the menu item's link.

footer.name: Footer
footer.demo_note_info: Shown at the bottom of every page.

hero.name: Hero
hero.heading: Heading
hero.heading_info: Each line here becomes a line in the headline. Break where the thought breaks.
hero.show_3d_info: Phones on low power, Save Data and browsers without WebGL see the image below instead.
hero.image_info: Used when the 3D runner is off or cannot run. 16:9 works best.
hero.show_stars_info: Only while festive mode is on.
hero.show_3d_mobile_info: Turn off for a faster mobile score: phones then show the flat runner (or the image), desktops keep the 3D.

collection_tiles.name: Shop by collection
collection_tiles.heading: Heading
collection_tiles.show_count: Show number of products when there is no caption
collection_tiles.title: Title
collection_tiles.title_info: Leave empty to use the collection's title.
collection_tiles.caption: Caption
collection_tiles.caption_info: A short line, for example what's inside.
collection_tiles.image_info: Leave empty to use the collection's image.

product_tabs.name: Product tabs
product_tabs.label: Accessible name
product_tabs.label_info: Read by screen readers to describe the tabs.
product_tabs.title: Tab title
product_tabs.collection_info: Leave empty to show the newest products.

tagline_reveal.name: Tagline reveal
tagline_reveal.caption: Caption
tagline_reveal.text_info: Each line here is a line on the page (two lines or more). Wrap words in *stars* to give them the accent colour.

shop_the_look.name: Shop the look
shop_the_look.image_info: A styled photo, 5:4 on desktop. Place each dot with the sliders in its block.
shop_the_look.caption: Caption
shop_the_look.heading: Heading
shop_the_look.include_in_look_info: Turn off for things like gift boxes that already contain the other pieces.

craft_story.name: Craft story
craft_story.caption: Caption
craft_story.heading: Heading
craft_story.show_3d_info: The block follows the reader's scroll through the three steps. Phones on low power and Save Data see a flat drawing.
craft_story.title: Title
craft_story.show_3d_mobile_info: Turn off for a faster mobile score: phones then show a flat drawing of the print.

product_reels.name: Product reels
product_reels.caption: Caption
product_reels.heading: Heading
product_reels.video_info: A short vertical clip (9:16), 6 to 15 seconds, no sound needed. Leave empty to use the product's own video or photo.
product_reels.poster_info: Shown before the video plays and to people who turn off motion.
product_reels.reel_caption_info: Leave empty to show the product title.

gift_finder.name: Gift finder
gift_finder.heading: Heading
gift_finder.title: Title
gift_finder.tag_info: Used when no collection is picked: links to all products with this tag, for example gift-under-999.
gift_finder.image_info: Leave empty to show three product photos that fan out on hover.
gift_finder.festive_only_info: Hidden while festive mode is off.

reviews.name: Reviews
reviews.heading: Heading
reviews.label: Label
reviews.label_info: Keep this visible on a demo store so nobody mistakes sample reviews for real ones.
reviews.product_name_info: Shown when no product is picked, or the product is not in the store yet.

product.name: Product
product.show_dynamic_checkout_info: Shop Pay, UPI apps and other express checkouts your store has turned on.
product.promise_info: One per line, shown with a tick under the button.

recommendations.name: Product recommendations
recommendations.heading_complementary_info: Pick complementary products per product in the free Search & Discovery app.

cart_drawer.name: Cart drawer
cart_drawer.show_gift: Show gift wrap and card note
cart_drawer.pairs_collection_info: Items already in the cart are skipped. Leave empty to use all products.
cart_drawer.empty_collection: Collection to suggest when the cart is empty

password_page.message: Message (when the store has no password message)

rich_text.name: Rich text
rich_text.caption: Caption
rich_text.heading: Heading
rich_text.heading_info: Each line here is a line on the page.

image_text.name: Image with text
image_text.number_info: Large number above the text, for example 01.
image_text.caption: Caption
image_text.heading: Heading
